items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

ctx.x: Well we probably have an incorrect vision of Italy because we see in ads and in tours, you know take a tour of the best parts of Italy. So if we were to relocate to somewhere in Italy we probably —

Yeah. Every country sees the downside. Of course we want to portray the best of us. It’s like when you go on a date app — you want to put your best picture and your best characteristics. You know? So I think every country — I mean we have — right now we have a very bad economical situation. Kind of similar to what it was here a few years — a couple of years ago with the Republican — not Republican, we’ll say with Trump. But so right now, you know we have a lot of poverty and unfortunately we have also a lot of…

Well I’ll lighten up a little bit. I don’t usually ask people about their gear, but I had a thing this morning I had to play tenor and I reminded myself what a lousy horn I have. Can you tell me what sax and mouthpiece you use?
